title: Some ambiguous values listed in Shortcuts on Home screen

judgment.rationale: The report names both ambiguous rows and current view-model source uses the identical resource for both; localized presentation still needs validation.
evidence: The Home shortcuts view lists Find My Mouse and Quick Accent as generic Activation entries, making their icons the main distinction.
The report also asks about Command Palette closing and updating Quick Access; these are separate concerns.

The pinned dashboard view model uses the same Dashboard_Activation label in both Find My Mouse and Quick Accent entries: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/ViewModels/DashboardViewModel.cs.

proposed_fixes.title: Disambiguate Home activation shortcut labels
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Giving these shortcut entries their module-specific localized names should remove the ambiguity; verify layout and resource choices before implementation.
plan: Use module-specific localized labels for the Find My Mouse and Quick Accent activation rows instead of the shared generic label.
Review the Always on Top wording independently and preserve existing shortcut values and accessibility names.
Add view-model or UI coverage that distinguishes the two rows; leave the unrelated Command Palette and Quick Access questions to separate triage.
verification: Home identifies each activation row by utility in supported languages and still displays the correct configured gesture.
